title: ORCA Computing
summary: London company building photonic quantum computers with a modular, fibre-connected design.
bodyHtml:
ORCA Computing develops photonic quantum systems built from modules connected by optical fibre, aiming at a path to scale without a single monolithic cryostat.

The company has worked with research and enterprise partners on early quantum machine-learning and optimisation experiments.

Why it matters

  • Modular photonic architecture
  • Fibre-linked quantum modules
  • Early enterprise access

businessMeaning: Modularity is attractive because it turns a manufacturing problem into a networking problem, but every module adds loss.
investmentLens: Private; a long-horizon photonics bet rather than a near-term revenue story.
